examples.en: Thank you for helping me with my homework.
examples.zh: 謝謝你幫我寫功課。

examples.en: Do you want to join us for lunch?
examples.zh: 你想和我們一起吃午餐嗎？

examples.en: I will call you as soon as I get home.
examples.zh: 我一到家就會打電話給你。

examples.en: Please show your ticket to the guard.
examples.zh: 請向警衛出示你的票。

examples.en: Is this your umbrella or mine?
examples.zh: 這是你的雨傘還是我的？

examples.en: Thank you for your help with the project.
examples.zh: 謝謝你們協助這個專案。

examples.en: I admire my teacher for her patience.
examples.zh: 我很敬佩我的老師有耐心。

examples.en: Tourists stopped to admire the view from the hill.
examples.zh: 遊客停下來欣賞山上的景色。

examples.en: Many students admire the captain of the baseball team.
examples.zh: 許多學生很欣賞棒球隊的隊長。

examples.en: The doctor advised him to get more sleep.
examples.zh: 醫生建議他多睡一點。

examples.en: I advise you to check the weather before you go.
examples.zh: 我勸你出門前先看看天氣。

examples.en: Our manager advised us to finish the report early.
examples.zh: 我們的經理提醒我們要提早完成報告。

examples.en: Children learn the alphabet in kindergarten.
examples.zh: 孩子們在幼兒園學習字母表。

examples.en: The English alphabet has twenty-six letters.
examples.zh: 英文字母表有二十六個字母。

examples.en: She sang the alphabet song with her little brother.
examples.zh: 她和弟弟一起唱字母歌。

examples.en: An ambulance arrived at the school in five minutes.
examples.zh: 救護車五分鐘內就抵達了學校。

examples.en: Please make way for the ambulance on the road.
examples.zh: 請讓出道路給救護車。

examples.en: He called an ambulance when his neighbor fell down the stairs.
examples.zh: 鄰居從樓梯摔下來時，他叫了救護車。

examples.en: The children dressed as angels for the school play.
examples.zh: 孩子們為學校的戲劇打扮成天使。

examples.en: There is a small angel on top of the Christmas tree.
examples.zh: 聖誕樹的頂端有一個小天使。

examples.en: Our nurse is an angel who always helps people.
examples.zh: 我們的護理師是個總是幫助別人的天使。

examples.en: I apologize for being late to the meeting.
examples.zh: 我為開會遲到向大家道歉。

examples.en: He apologized to his mother for breaking the vase.
examples.zh: 他為打破花瓶向媽媽道歉。

examples.en: The store apologized to customers for the long wait.
examples.zh: 商店為讓顧客久等而道歉。

examples.en: She works as an assistant in a dentist's office.
examples.zh: 她在牙醫診所擔任助理。

examples.en: The shop assistant showed us where the shoes were.
examples.zh: 店員告訴我們鞋子放在哪裡。

examples.en: Our teacher asked her assistant to hand out the tests.
examples.zh: 老師請助理把考卷發下去。

examples.en: He was named assistant manager last month.
examples.zh: 他上個月被任命為副理。

examples.en: Ms. Lin is the assistant coach of our basketball team.
examples.zh: 林老師是我們籃球隊的助理教練。

examples.en: The assistant principal announced the new schedule.
examples.zh: 副校長宣布了新的時間表。

examples.en: I assume the store is closed on Sundays.
examples.zh: 我猜這家店星期天沒開。

examples.en: Don't assume that everyone knows the answer.
examples.zh: 不要以為每個人都知道答案。

examples.en: She will assume her new duties next Monday.
examples.zh: 她下星期一要開始承擔新的職責。

examples.en: We keep old boxes in the basement.
examples.zh: 我們把舊箱子放在地下室。

examples.en: The supermarket is in the basement of the mall.
examples.zh: 超級市場在購物中心的地下樓層。

examples.en: Water came into the basement after the heavy rain.
examples.zh: 大雨過後，水流進了地下室。

examples.en: I don't want to go out; besides, it's raining.
examples.zh: 我不想出門，而且外面正在下雨。

examples.en: The hotel is cheap. Besides, it is near the station.
examples.zh: 這間旅館很便宜，而且離車站很近。

examples.en: It is too late to call. Besides, he may be asleep.
examples.zh: 現在打電話太晚了，而且他可能已經睡了。

examples.en: Besides English, she also speaks Japanese.
examples.zh: 除了英文以外，她也會說日文。

examples.en: Who else came to the party besides Tom?
examples.zh: 除了湯姆以外，還有誰來參加派對？

examples.en: Besides homework, we have a test tomorrow.
examples.zh: 除了作業以外，我們明天還有考試。

examples.en: This coffee tastes too bitter without sugar.
examples.zh: 這杯咖啡不加糖喝起來太苦了。

examples.en: She felt bitter about losing the game.
examples.zh: 她對輸掉比賽感到很苦澀。

examples.en: A bitter wind blew across the empty field.
examples.zh: 刺骨的寒風吹過空曠的田野。

examples.en: She wore a white blouse and a black skirt.
examples.zh: 她穿了一件白襯衫和一條黑裙子。

examples.en: This blouse is too small for me.
examples.zh: 這件罩衫我穿太小了。

examples.en: My mother bought a silk blouse at the department store.
examples.zh: 我媽媽在百貨公司買了一件絲質襯衫。

examples.en: The old bomb was removed from the construction site.
examples.zh: 那顆舊炸彈已被從工地移走。

examples.en: Police closed the street after a bomb threat.
examples.zh: 接到炸彈威脅後，警方封鎖了街道。

examples.en: The museum has a display about a bomb from the old war.
examples.zh: 博物館有一個展示舊戰爭時期炸彈的區域。

examples.en: Planes bombed the bridge during the old war.
examples.zh: 戰爭期間飛機轟炸了那座橋。

examples.en: The history book explains why they bombed the port.
examples.zh: 這本歷史書解釋了他們轟炸港口的原因。

examples.en: The old town was bombed many years ago.
examples.zh: 那座老城鎮多年前被轟炸過。

examples.en: There is a tall bookcase next to my desk.
examples.zh: 我的書桌旁邊有一個高高的書櫃。

examples.en: He put his dictionaries on the top shelf of the bookcase.
examples.zh: 他把字典放在書櫃的最上層。

examples.en: We bought a new bookcase for the living room.
examples.zh: 我們幫客廳買了一個新書櫃。

examples.en: My friends and I went bowling on Saturday.
examples.zh: 我和朋友星期六去打保齡球。

examples.en: Bowling is a popular sport in Taiwan.
examples.zh: 保齡球在台灣是很受歡迎的運動。

examples.en: The bowling alley is open until midnight.
examples.zh: 這間保齡球館營業到半夜。

examples.en: The radio station broadcasts news every hour.
examples.zh: 這家電台每小時播報新聞。

examples.en: The final game will be broadcast live tonight.
examples.zh: 決賽今晚將現場直播。

examples.en: They broadcast the school concert on the Internet.
examples.zh: 他們把學校音樂會在網路上播出。

examples.en: I listened to the morning broadcast on my way to work.
examples.zh: 我上班途中聽了早晨的廣播節目。

examples.en: The weather broadcast says it will rain tomorrow.
examples.zh: 氣象廣播說明天會下雨。

examples.en: The live broadcast began at eight o'clock.
examples.zh: 現場轉播在八點開始。

examples.en: We had brunch at a cafe on Sunday.
examples.zh: 我們星期天在咖啡廳吃了早午餐。

examples.en: Brunch includes eggs, toast, and fresh fruit.
examples.zh: 早午餐有蛋、吐司和新鮮水果。

examples.en: Let's meet for brunch before the movie.
examples.zh: 我們看電影前先碰面吃早午餐吧。

examples.en: He filled the bucket with water from the tap.
examples.zh: 他用水龍頭的水把水桶裝滿。

examples.en: The children carried buckets of sand to the beach.
examples.zh: 孩子們提著幾桶沙子到海邊。

examples.en: Please put the wet cloth in the bucket.
examples.zh: 請把濕布放進桶子裡。

examples.en: The hotel serves a big breakfast buffet every morning.
examples.zh: 這間旅館每天早上都供應豐盛的自助早餐。

examples.en: We ate at a seafood buffet for my father's birthday.
examples.zh: 為了慶祝爸爸的生日，我們去吃了海鮮自助餐。

examples.en: There is a salad buffet next to the main dishes.
examples.zh: 主菜旁邊有一個沙拉自助吧。

examples.en: He carried a bundle of newspapers to the recycling center.
examples.zh: 他把一捆報紙帶到回收站。

examples.en: The farmer tied the sticks into a bundle.
examples.zh: 農夫把樹枝綁成一捆。

examples.en: She gave me a bundle of old letters.
examples.zh: 她給了我一捆舊信件。

examples.en: Please bundle the old magazines with string.
examples.zh: 請用繩子把舊雜誌捆起來。

examples.en: The workers bundled the cables before moving them.
examples.zh: 工人在搬動前先把電纜捆好。

examples.en: We bundled the vegetables and put them in a box.
examples.zh: 我們把蔬菜綁成一束，放進箱子裡。

examples.en: A thick cable connects the computer to the printer.
examples.zh: 一條粗電纜把電腦連接到印表機。

examples.en: The bridge is held up by strong steel cables.
examples.zh: 這座橋由堅固的鋼纜支撐。

examples.en: My grandparents watch cable every evening.
examples.zh: 我的祖父母每天晚上都看有線電視。

examples.en: Students eat lunch in the school cafeteria.
examples.zh: 學生們在學校餐廳吃午餐。

examples.en: The cafeteria serves rice, vegetables, and soup.
examples.zh: 這間餐廳供應米飯、蔬菜和湯。

examples.en: We met our coach in the cafeteria after class.
examples.zh: 下課後我們在餐廳遇見了教練。

examples.en: The campus is full of tall trees and bicycles.
examples.zh: 校園裡滿是高大的樹木和腳踏車。

examples.en: New students took a tour of the campus.
examples.zh: 新生參加了校園導覽。

examples.en: Our university has two campuses in the city.
examples.zh: 我們大學在市區有兩個校區。

examples.en: Our captain led the team onto the field.
examples.zh: 我們的隊長帶領球隊走上球場。

examples.en: The captain of the ship welcomed everyone on board.
examples.zh: 船長歡迎所有人登船。

examples.en: The captain told the passengers to fasten their seat belts.
examples.zh: 機長請乘客繫好安全帶。

examples.en: She will captain the volleyball team this year.
examples.zh: 她今年將擔任排球隊的隊長。

examples.en: He captained the boat across the lake.
examples.zh: 他指揮船隻橫渡湖面。

examples.en: Who captained your team last season?
examples.zh: 你們球隊上一季是誰當隊長？

examples.en: The living room has a soft gray carpet.
examples.zh: 客廳鋪著一條柔軟的灰色地毯。

examples.en: Please take off your shoes before walking on the carpet.
examples.zh: 走上地毯之前請先脫鞋。

examples.en: We rolled up the old carpet and carried it outside.
examples.zh: 我們把舊地毯捲起來搬到外面。

examples.en: She hung her coat in the closet.
examples.zh: 她把大衣掛在衣櫥裡。

examples.en: My brother keeps his sports shoes in the hall closet.
examples.zh: 我弟弟把運動鞋放在走廊的壁櫥裡。

examples.en: The closet is full of clothes I never wear.
examples.zh: 衣櫥裡塞滿了我從來沒穿過的衣服。

examples.en: Our basketball coach teaches us to work as a team.
examples.zh: 我們的籃球教練教我們團隊合作。

examples.en: The tour coach left the hotel at eight.
examples.zh: 遊覽車八點離開旅館。

examples.en: She is a vocal coach for young singers.
examples.zh: 她是年輕歌手的聲樂教練。

examples.en: Mr. Wang coaches the school baseball team.
examples.zh: 王老師指導學校的棒球隊。

examples.en: She coaches students for the speech contest.
examples.zh: 她指導學生準備演講比賽。

examples.en: My uncle coached me before the swimming test.
examples.zh: 游泳測驗前，我叔叔訓練過我。

examples.en: The market was full of colorful fruit and flowers.
examples.zh: 市場裡滿是色彩繽紛的水果和花朵。

examples.en: She wore a colorful scarf to the party.
examples.zh: 她戴著一條色彩鮮豔的圍巾去參加派對。

examples.en: The kids drew a colorful picture of the park.
examples.zh: 孩子們畫了一幅公園的彩色圖畫。

examples.en: Stop complaining about the food and eat your dinner.
examples.zh: 別再抱怨食物了，快吃你的晚餐。

examples.en: Customers complained about the slow service.
examples.zh: 顧客抱怨服務太慢。

examples.en: He complained to the manager about the noisy room.
examples.zh: 他向經理投訴房間太吵。

examples.en: The long instructions confused many students.
examples.zh: 冗長的說明讓許多學生感到困惑。

examples.en: Don't confuse the two words; they have different meanings.
examples.zh: 別把這兩個字搞混，它們的意思不同。

examples.en: The new schedule may confuse some passengers.
examples.zh: 新的時刻表可能會讓一些乘客搞不清楚。

examples.en: This shirt is made of soft cotton.
examples.zh: 這件襯衫是用柔軟的棉布做的。

examples.en: Farmers grow cotton in the warm fields.
examples.zh: 農夫在溫暖的田裡種棉花。

examples.en: She cleaned the cut with a piece of cotton.
examples.zh: 她用一小團棉花清理傷口。

examples.en: He coughed all night because of the cold.
examples.zh: 他因為感冒咳了一整晚。

examples.en: Please cover your mouth when you cough.
examples.zh: 咳嗽的時候請遮住嘴巴。

examples.en: The smoke made everyone in the room cough.
examples.zh: 煙讓房間裡的每個人都咳了起來。

examples.en: I have a bad cough and a sore throat.
examples.zh: 我咳得很厲害，喉嚨也痛。

examples.en: The doctor gave her medicine for her cough.
examples.zh: 醫生開了咳嗽藥給她。

examples.en: We heard a loud cough from the back of the class.
examples.zh: 我們聽到教室後面傳來很大的咳嗽聲。

examples.en: A small crab walked across the sand.
examples.zh: 一隻小螃蟹爬過沙灘。

examples.en: We had steamed crab for dinner at the seafood restaurant.
examples.zh: 我們在海鮮餐廳晚餐吃了清蒸螃蟹。

examples.en: The children caught a crab in the shallow water.
examples.zh: 孩子們在淺水中抓到了一隻螃蟹。

examples.en: It is cruel to leave a dog outside in the cold.
examples.zh: 把狗留在寒冷的屋外是很殘忍的。

examples.en: The teacher told us not to be cruel to animals.
examples.zh: 老師告訴我們不要對動物殘忍。

examples.en: Her cruel words made him feel sad.
examples.zh: 她冷酷的話讓他覺得很難過。

examples.en: We woke up at dawn to see the sunrise.
examples.zh: 我們天一亮就起床看日出。

examples.en: The birds begin to sing at dawn.
examples.zh: 鳥兒在黎明時開始鳴唱。

examples.en: The invention marked the dawn of a new age.
examples.zh: 這項發明標誌著新時代的開端。

examples.en: The day dawned bright and clear.
examples.zh: 那天天亮時天氣晴朗。

examples.en: It suddenly dawned on me that I had left my keys at home.
examples.zh: 我忽然想到自己把鑰匙忘在家裡了。

examples.en: Morning dawned over the quiet village.
examples.zh: 晨光在寧靜的村莊上方亮起。

examples.en: We decorated the classroom for the festival.
examples.zh: 我們為園遊會佈置了教室。

examples.en: She decorated the cake with strawberries.
examples.zh: 她用草莓裝飾蛋糕。

examples.en: They decorate the tree with lights every December.
examples.zh: 他們每年十二月都用燈飾裝飾那棵樹。

examples.en: The number of students decreased this year.
examples.zh: 今年的學生人數減少了。

examples.en: Exercise can decrease the risk of heart disease.
examples.zh: 運動可以降低心臟病的風險。

examples.en: Prices decrease when more stores sell the same product.
examples.zh: 當更多商店賣同樣的產品時，價格就會下降。

examples.en: There was a sharp decrease in sales last month.
examples.zh: 上個月的銷售量大幅下降。

examples.en: The report shows a decrease in air pollution.
examples.zh: 報告顯示空氣汙染減少了。

examples.en: A decrease in temperature is expected tonight.
examples.zh: 今晚預計氣溫會下降。

examples.en: She has a strong desire to study abroad.
examples.zh: 她很渴望出國留學。

examples.en: He felt no desire to eat after the long trip.
examples.zh: 長途旅行後，他一點也不想吃東西。

examples.en: Their desire for success helped them work hard.
examples.zh: 他們對成功的渴望讓他們努力工作。

examples.en: Everyone desires a safe and happy life.
examples.zh: 每個人都渴望安全快樂的生活。

examples.en: The company desires to hire more workers.
examples.zh: 公司希望能多聘請一些員工。

examples.en: He desired a quiet place to study.
examples.zh: 他想要一個安靜的地方念書。

examples.en: We shared a chocolate dessert after dinner.
examples.zh: 晚餐後我們分著吃了一份巧克力甜點。

examples.en: What would you like for dessert tonight?
examples.zh: 你今晚想吃什麼甜點？

examples.en: This restaurant is famous for its mango dessert.
examples.zh: 這間餐廳以芒果甜點聞名。

examples.en: Dinosaurs lived on Earth millions of years ago.
examples.zh: 恐龍在數百萬年前生活在地球上。

examples.en: My little brother loves his toy dinosaur.
examples.zh: 我弟弟很喜歡他的玩具恐龍。

examples.en: We saw a giant dinosaur skeleton at the museum.
examples.zh: 我們在博物館看到一具巨大的恐龍骨架。

examples.en: It is dishonest to copy your friend's homework.
examples.zh: 抄朋友的作業是不誠實的。

examples.en: The dishonest seller gave us the wrong change.
examples.zh: 那個不誠實的賣家找錯錢給我們。

examples.en: Nobody trusts a dishonest person for long.
examples.zh: 沒有人會長久信任一個不誠實的人。

examples.en: I felt dizzy after riding the roller coaster.
examples.zh: 搭完雲霄飛車後，我覺得頭暈。

examples.en: She stood up too fast and became dizzy.
examples.zh: 她站起來太快，覺得頭暈目眩。

examples.en: The hot weather made the old man dizzy.
examples.zh: 炎熱的天氣讓老先生頭暈。

examples.en: A dolphin jumped out of the water near our boat.
examples.zh: 一隻海豚在我們的船旁邊躍出水面。

examples.en: Dolphins are smart animals that live in groups.
examples.zh: 海豚是群居的聰明動物。

examples.en: The children laughed at the dolphin show.
examples.zh: 孩子們被海豚表演逗得哈哈大笑。

examples.en: The farmer rode a donkey to the market.
examples.zh: 農夫騎著驢子去市場。

examples.en: A donkey carried the bags up the hill.
examples.zh: 一隻驢子把袋子載上山坡。

examples.en: The children fed carrots to the donkey.
examples.zh: 孩子們餵驢子吃紅蘿蔔。

examples.en: I bought a doughnut for breakfast.
examples.zh: 我買了一個甜甜圈當早餐。

examples.en: The doughnut shop is next to the bus stop.
examples.zh: 甜甜圈店就在公車站旁邊。

examples.en: She put sugar on each doughnut.
examples.zh: 她在每個甜甜圈上撒了糖。

examples.en: We took the bus downtown to see a movie.
examples.zh: 我們搭公車去市中心看電影。

examples.en: My aunt works downtown near the main station.
examples.zh: 我阿姨在主車站附近的市中心上班。

examples.en: They walked downtown after lunch.
examples.zh: 午餐後他們走路到市中心。

examples.en: The downtown area is busy on weekends.
examples.zh: 市中心地區在週末很熱鬧。

examples.en: We stayed at a downtown hotel last summer.
examples.zh: 去年夏天我們住在市中心的一家旅館。

examples.en: A new downtown library will open next year.
examples.zh: 一間新的市區圖書館明年將開放。

examples.en: I bought cold medicine at the drugstore.
examples.zh: 我在藥妝店買了感冒藥。

examples.en: The drugstore on the corner closes at ten.
examples.zh: 轉角的藥局十點關門。

examples.en: She works at a drugstore near the school.
examples.zh: 她在學校附近的一家藥妝店工作。

examples.en: That was a dumb mistake, and I am sorry.
examples.zh: 那是個愚蠢的錯誤，我很抱歉。

examples.en: Don't call your classmate dumb; it hurts his feelings.
examples.zh: 不要說你的同學笨，那會傷他的心。

examples.en: It would be dumb to go out in this storm.
examples.zh: 在這種暴風雨中出門太蠢了。
